news.title: Incoming Young Democrats in Senate Want Chuck Schumer Out
news.description: Incoming freshman and young Democratic senators want to replace Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer with 67-year-old Democratic Maryland Sen. Chris Van Hollen. A handful of Democrats opposed Schumer’s potential leadership at a time when Democratic voters have been ousting the old-guard and establishment members of their party. Some incoming senators, including 42-year-old Democratic Michigan Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed and 47-year-old Democratic Minnesota Sen.-elect Peggy Flanagan expressed support for Van Hollen over Schumer, arguing they want generational change in leadership.
